notes._tasks: Task names are short Egyptian Arabic translations of the source task headings in docs/reference/ (Story 2.16); author to confirm.
notes._all: Author decision: all step and activity sentences use the first-person plural 'let's' form (يلا نـ…) so they fit boys and girls and the character acts with the child. UI labels are [ASSUMPTION] from EXPERIENCE.md pending author review; praise changed from شاطر! to the neutral برافو!.
notes.eat.sandwich.06: Source 'in a way that suits your motor abilities' simplified to 'the way that is comfortable for us'; author to confirm.
notes.dress.jacket.on.01: Source steps for dressing are third-person observation criteria; rendered literally as 'let's' instructions.
notes.dress.shirt.on.05: 'at a regular rhythm' rendered as 'at the same speed'; author to confirm.
notes.dress.tshirt.on.04: 'sequential, organised movement' is ambiguous for a child; kept literal.
notes.hygiene.teeth.12: Safety condition kept literally ('if we can do so safely').
notes.mild.hand.08: Activity title 'pincer grasp' rendered as 'hold with our thumb and index finger'.
notes.mild.midline.09: 'across the body' rendered as 'from in front of our body to the other side'; author to confirm.
notes.mild.planning.01: Activity titles are noun phrases; rendered as short 'let's' sentences of the same action.
notes.moderate.midline.01: 'the opposite shoulder/knee/ear' rendered as 'the other shoulder/knee/ear' (الكتف التاني); author to confirm.
notes.moderate.midline.09: 'crossed coloured targets' is ambiguous; kept literal ('the opposite coloured targets').
notes.severe.coord.06: 'therapist' rendered as الأخصائي (masculine); author may prefer الأخصائية.
